__doc__: Locals whose own site publishes a job-calls / referral list. Keyed by the local's slug (the `id` in the ranked list). Add an entry to scrape another local; `scripts/scrape-job-calls.mjs` parses each `url` and writes js/data/job-calls.json. Most union sites run the same UnionActive CMS as IBEW 606, so the parser should carry over — spot-check a new one with `node scripts/scrape-job-calls.mjs --only <slug>`.
